facts.fact: The Nzika Digital ID Wallet, which lets citizens securely present verified identity credentials digitally, was officially launched in Lilongwe, the article says.
The Homeland Security Minister said citizens can adopt a digital credential through the Nzika Digital ID Wallet as an option alongside the physical card.

MWI.note: The document does not mention civil register and ID exchange.
The document gives no count or share of people enrolled.
The document does not mention a number at birth.
The document does not say who operates or maintains the ID system.
The document does not mention registers keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: The article refers to the existing physical National Identity Card, which the Nzika wallet complements, and says National Identity Cards will no longer have expiry dates.
